implementation_notes: The package is the module; the compiler enforces the cut only if you do not export implementation. Put exported types in one file per package, keep helpers unexported, and let packages depend on interfaces (not structs) at the seam.
idiom_name: package as module + exported surface in one file
code_sketch:
package pricing

type Calculator interface{ Total(Order) Money }   // exported surface
exported-only: // impl stays unexported
type defaultCalc struct{}
pitfalls: Exporting every helper so "packages can use them"
Import cycles that force merging two genuinely separate modules
